Then that means Prysm was still having issues with it. you can filter for NOT lodestar-ethrex-1 nodes 😂 prysm-geth-1 seems to be getting some missed payloads looking into it <@586161934425128960> could give more details, but it's a malicious node to test clients. Slashed quite some big eth validators and they haven't been scheduled to propose any future slots https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/slot/1034 Validator 12 got slashed in slot 1012 and proposed 1034, but thats due to the normal N+1 proposal lookahead rule, so thats still fair game. <@412614104222531604> is Dora API down for devent-6? (not saying I'm having any issues at all, just double checking since it was said in the ACDC that it was going to be down) I believe he was just joking 😄 he was going to shut it down to encourage devs to review/merge PRs. it's a malicious proposer that always builds on empty (ie. reorgs timely payloads) and withholds ptc votes in blocks to hide the malicious act but `lodestar-ethrex-1` itself should do fine in terms of following the chain, but what we wanna see in the devnet is that all clients vote against `deathstar` blocks so that it get orphaned, so the next proposer should **always** reorg it out of the canonical chain and get sufficient weight even if the `deathstar` block gets proposer boost Prysm missing payload looks like a geth bug. ``` WARN NewPayload: inserting block failed error="block used too much gas in bottleneck dimension: 60124944. block gas limit is 60058592" ERROR execution: Got a validation error in newPayload error=block used too much gas in bottleneck dimension... status=INVALID ``` Prysm missing block is a prysm bug. ``` ERROR rpc/validator: Finished building block error=... Could not compute state root: could not process block header: proposer at index 7 was previously slashed ``` cc <@&688090867927482525> nimbus-ethrex-1 and only nimbus-ethrex-1 seems to be intermittently having real issues (of nimbus nodes) but the blocks that `deathstar` produces shouldn't be shown as missing but as orphaned by dora it seems like there was an issue with processing the payload and it's stuck since then, seems like EL issue to me ``` Jun-25 14:42:00.804[execution] warn: Execution client is syncing oldState=SYNCED, newState=SYNCING Jun-25 14:42:00.805[chain] warn: Error processing execution payload from gossip slot=960, peer=16Uiu2HAmBNvwPgqoJccKumdST8HEXstL9SHWPNJhHDanTX9ywJyu, root=0xac79aaae0f5085ec4358c6681da36ed9ecc3bcaa5d5f5e5a8223063e35172116 - PAYLOAD_ERROR_EXECUTION_ENGINE_INVALID Error: PAYLOAD_ERROR_EXECUTION_ENGINE_INVALID ``` <@281967554572976128> no i think this is valid, the slashing happened after lookahead was already settled so we did the right thing Then why is there an error? Did someone else do something wrong? the error is wrong / cosmetic, but you are slashed then you shouldn't propose at first place Oh I see. This is coming from the node with the slashed validator. That wasn't clear to me. Sounds good. which validator would have proposed on which slot? plz cross check ``` │ Missed slot │ Epoch │ Lookahead committed at │ Slashed at │ Result │ │ 1007, 1010 │ 31 │ start of epoch 30 │ epoch 31 │ committed before slash → still in lookahead → miss │ │ 1034, 1051 │ 32 │ start of epoch 31 │ epoch 31 (later, in a regular block) │ committed before slash → still in lookahead → miss │ │ Missed slot │ Epoch │ Validator index │ Pubkey prefix │ │ 1007 │ 31 │ 7 │ 0xa09de51de2d8 │ │ 1010 │ 31 │ 3 │ 0x87808d09e908 │ │ 1034 │ 32 │ 12 │ 0x95574ea8769 │ │ 1051 │ 32 │ 18 │ 0xa137854cebc │ └─────────────┴───────┴─────────────────┴────────────────┘ ``` Seems that deathstar is running with a glamsterdam-devnet-5 ethrex node. It has an issue that we fixed in glam-6 ah that explains the `PAYLOAD_ERROR_EXECUTION_ENGINE_INVALID`, that block likely had builder deposits, or maybe some other state change, I didn't check the ehtrex logs, but that's definitely the wrong image, it has `ethpandaops/ethrex:glamsterdam-devnet-5` deployed forgot to ask on acdc but anyone opposed to taking devnet 5 offline now that we have devnet 6. If I don't hear from anyone I'll note it down as safe to be yeeted. So expect it to be gone by EOD unless otherwise stated. A few missed payloads here from prysm & lighthouse. Any ideas? glamsterdam-devnet-5 is dead 💀 builder side? time for that circuit breaker implementation 🤣 if it helps, the failed ones always have blobs. POSTs the `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope` to its own Lighthouse beacon node at `/eth/v1/beacon/execution_payload_envelopes`. Lighthouse rejects it <@358120958726373381> what can you bring up in your defense? This is useful! Thanks.
